notes:
Qualification summary:
- Customer: mid-size healthcare SaaS serving EU hospitals; strict data residency (EU for PHI) and audit retention requirements.
- Primary workload: real-time clinical assistant + document search for patient records (embeddings + reranking). Latency target: 100-250ms p99 for short-turn chat; throughput spikes during rounds. Cost sensitive but will pay for compliance guarantees.
Architecture fit (initial):
- Prefer Private VPC deployment in eu-west-1 with an option to deploy in us-east-1 for US customers; MUST guarantee that PHI data and model inference stay within EU region unless contractually scoped.
- VPC topology requested: private subnets with NAT gateway for controlled egress, interface endpoints to S3 and KMS, no public load balancer for inference control plane. Encryption-at-rest with customer-managed KMS (BYOK/HSM) required.
- Inbound/outbound: inbound from hospital VPN/IPs via NGW + private endpoints; outbound restricted to select telemetry endpoints (Redwood control plane) — they want IP allowlist.
- Audit logging: 7-year retention for infer logs + admin audit; logs must forward to customer SIEM (S3 + Kinesis/HTTP webhook). Need proof-of-concept for audit forwarding and immutable logs.
- KMS integration: require customer master key with key rotation policy and cross-account grants. Need examples of key policy and steps for Redwood to access keys for runtime (grant template requested).
- Network & security asks: TLS mutual auth for control plane, SAML SSO for console, SCIM for provisioning, SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence. Pen test window requested.
Quotes / customer color: "We cannot accept model weights or tokenized PHI leaving EU region without an exec-level DPA." — Head of Security.
Sticking points: Legal wants explicit cross-border flow matrix; infra wants egress IP list and port matrix; security wants BYOK HSM integration timeline.
Suggested Redwood approach: deliver a crisp VPC topology diagram (two variants: single-region EU private with DR in US on request; multi-region with model routing policy), sample KMS grant policy, and a short playbook for audit log forwarding. Attach cost delta for Dedicated reserved vs Private single-tenant.
Next actions (short): draft architecture + cost, set up 1:1 with Opal security on 2026-03-17, produce KMS BYOK implementation plan.
